image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on a gravelly, rocky ground. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur with darker ticking, large upright ears with dark tips, and a visible dark eye. Its body is compact and rounded, with hind legs tucked beneath it. The background consists of out-of-focus rocks and pebbles.
